protocol.truth_scope: Evaluation-only analytic fixtures, saved background geometry, and exact copied visible robot triangle meshes. Never runtime RGB-D input.
protocol.surface_measure: Area-weighted convex analytic physical surfaces, front-facing and unoccluded along calibrated optical rays; full physical back surfaces remain denominator.
protocol.empty_scope: Empty means no additional fixtures; original final-scene visual objects and the robot remain.
protocol.depth_scope: No claim of native depth counts from this screen. Raw rendered pixel counts require native shortlist capture.
protocol.probe_scope: 40mm external actual-link AABB face probes plus bounded hover/side path neighborhoods; sampled poses are not a continuous swept-volume proof.
protocol.physical_mount_scope: Optical viewpoints only. No camera housing/cable model or mount feasibility is inferred.
protocol.wrist_scope: Hypothetical hand-relative viewpoint evaluated from each copied robot pose. No wrist sensor attached, calibrated, synchronized or implemented.
protocol.probe_occlusion_scope: Link-neighborhood and workspace-bin probes include the robot and original background only; fixture-specific occlusion is evaluated in separate physical surface rows.
protocol.swept_scope: Five captured endpoint postures plus a local hover/side corridor; complete interpolated full-arm swept-volume coverage is unmeasured.
